attackers_goals: An attacker may gain persistence and execute malicious tools via scheduled tasks.
description: A signed process created a scheduled task via file access. Attackers may create scheduled tasks for execution and to establish persistence.
investigative_actions: Check the created task file and look for the action triggered by the task.
name: Signed process creates a scheduled task via file access
